evidence: Adds CI workflow and container orchestration scripts to build and test Guix release binaries under .github/workflows/guix.yml, ci/, and contrib/guix/.
rationale: Continuous testing of Guix release binaries and codesign manifests directly addresses release integrity before manual release engineering. As the PR notes, 'limited continuous testing of our exact release binaries' leaves custom static glibc toolchains and codesign manifests untested until release time, and adding this automation unblocks safe testing of work like #25573.
